blocks.tamil_translation: (When that Sahabi went to him and invited him) the mushrik asked, “The god to whom you are inviting me, is it made of silver? Is it made of brass?” The messenger of Rasulullah ﷺ could not bear these words of the mushrik. He came to the Prophet ﷺ and described what the mushrik had said. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Go back to that mushrik and invite him to the Deen.” So he went back and invited the mushrik, and he repeated what he had said before. That Sahabi came to Rasulullah ﷺ and told him what the mushrik had said. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Go back to him once again and invite him.” (He went to invite him for the third time.) He returned and came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, “Allah Ta'ala has destroyed that mushrik (by a thunderbolt).” When he came, Rasulullah ﷺ was on a journey and did not know about what had happened. At that time Allah Ta'ala revealed the following verse to Rasulullah ﷺ: (وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُمْ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اللهِ) “And Allah Ta'ala sends thunderbolts upon the earth and makes them strike whom He wills. Yet they dispute about Allah Ta'ala.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ لِمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ حِينَ بَعَثَهُ إِلي الْيَمَنِ: إِنَّكَ سَتَأْتِي قَوْماً أَهْلَ كِتَابٍ، فَإِذَا جِئْتَهُمْ فَادْعُهُمْ إِلي أَنْ يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَطَاعُوا لَكَ بِذلِكَ فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ فَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَطَاعُوا لَكَ بِذلِكَ فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ فَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَغْنِيَائِهِمْ فَتُرَدُّ
